You will be the primary manager for this installation.

hero.body: Élise connects cues from the home, your app and a loved one’s television to help families stay in touch.
hero.eyebrow: A DIFFERENT WAY TO STAY CONNECTED
hero.title: A gentle link

mobile.body: See the day’s facts, events and alerts. An unusual situation is a reason to check in, never a conclusion to draw from afar.
mobile.title: What matters, in your pocket.

privacy.body: Events are processed at home. Authorised relatives access their space through a private network. A camera is not needed for the home’s activity cues.
privacy.disclaimer: Élise is neither a medical device nor an emergency service. In an emergency, call 112.
privacy.title: The heart of the system stays at home.

sensors.body: An opening, movement or temperature provides context. None of these cues alone can tell you that everything is fine.
sensors.title: The home offers useful cues.

tv.body: Messages, media and appointments are designed for a simple screen. Video calling and automatic launch still need to be tested with the resident and their consent.
tv.title: The connection reaches the TV.
